nba_directive.reason_text: This client is already engaged and refinance-curious — the play calls for speed and a frictionless path to application, not re-selling. With a 3.62% rate on record, the banker's job is to answer directly and move straight to the soft pull.
nba_directive.recommended_strategy_text:
- Reply immediately and directly — do not open with a generic pitch or ask a string of discovery questions
  - Acknowledge their specific situation: 3.62% conventional, $422,959 remaining balance, $2,174/mo P&I
  - Answer whatever they actually asked first, before anything else

- Present the rate gap concretely using today's real numbers
  - Do NOT invent a current market rate — pull today's live conventional refi rate and show the spread vs. their 3.62%
  - Calculate the actual monthly P&I delta and state it in dollars (do not estimate)

- Skip the re-pitch — they are already bought in
  - Do not re-explain the value of refinancing or ask 'what are your goals?'
  - One sentence max on context, then move to action

- Drive immediately to the soft credit pull / application
  - Offer a direct e-sign link or a specific 10-minute callback window — give them a choice of exactly two options, not an open-ended ask
  - Example close: 'I can send you a soft-pull link right now — no impact to your credit — or we can jump on a 10-minute call today at [time]. Which works?'

- Keep the message short — 3 to 5 sentences total
  - Over-engagement kills conversion on hot leads; resist the urge to add more
